environment.description: NestJS microservice deployed in a Kubernetes pod with default container settings. Container runs with read-write filesystem, /tmp is writable (default emptyDir or container-local tmpfs). Pod has unrestricted egress via default Kubernetes networking with no NetworkPolicy applied. The service account has no special restrictions. DNS resolution uses CoreDNS with default caching (30s TTL respect). The node.js HTTP client uses system DNS resolver which re-resolves on each request.
